title: kk7.5: Document session stubs + config.example.toml
description:
What: Add doc comments to jmap/session.rs documenting known unimplemented endpoints, and create crates/mail/config.example.toml.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/mail/src/jmap/session.rs, add a module-level doc comment before the struct definitions explaining:
   - uploadUrl is advertised but /jmap/upload is not implemented in v1
   - eventSourceUrl is advertised but /jmap/eventsource is not implemented in v1
   - A future epic covers push notifications and uploads
   - base_url MUST be set to the external hostname in production for all URLs to work

2. Create crates/mail/config.example.toml with:
   [listen]
   addr = "0.0.0.0:8080"
   base_url = "https://mail.example.com"  # REQUIRED: external hostname for browser clients

   [cors]
   enabled = true
   allowed_origins = ["*"]  # or list specific origins for production

   [database]
   path = "/var/lib/usenet-ipfs/mail/mail.db"

   [auth]
   required = true
   [[auth.users]]
   username = "alice"
   password_hash = "b2$..."  # bcrypt hash

   [tls]
   # cert_path = "/etc/ssl/mail.crt"
   # key_path = "/etc/ssl/mail.key"

   [log]
   level = "info"
   format = "json"

Defensive programming:
- config.example.toml must not contain real credentials or real cert paths
- Doc comments must not reveal security-sensitive implementation details

Acceptance: cargo check passes; config.example.toml is valid TOML that parses as Config.
